title: Joshua 11
paragraphs: ¹ When Jabin king of Hazor heard what had happened, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, and to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph, ² and to the kings in the northern hill country, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills, and in the heights of Dor to the west, ³ to the Canaanites on the east and west, to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country, and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah. ⁴ They marched out with all their forces — a vast army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore — along with a great number of horses and chariots. ⁵ All these kings joined forces and came to camp together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

⁶ The LORD said to Joshua, Do not be afraid of them, for by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them over to Israel, dead. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots. ⁷ So Joshua and his entire fighting force came against them suddenly at the waters of Merom and attacked. ⁸ The LORD gave them into Israel's hand, and Israel struck them down and pursued them as far as Greater Sidon, Misrephoth Maim, and the Valley of Mizpah to the east, until not one survivor remained. ⁹ Joshua did to them as the LORD had told him — he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots. ¹⁰ At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and killed its king with the sword, for Hazor had formerly been the leading kingdom among all these nations.

¹¹ They put every person there to the sword and destroyed them completely — not a soul was left alive — and Joshua burned Hazor itself. ¹² Joshua captured all the cities of those kings and killed their kings with the sword, destroying them completely, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded. ¹³ But Israel did not burn any of the cities that still stood on their mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua burned. ¹⁴ The Israelites carried off all the livestock and plunder from these cities for themselves, but they put every person to the sword until they had destroyed them all, leaving no one alive. ¹⁵ Just as the LORD had commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua carried it out fully — he left nothing undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses.

¹⁶ So Joshua took all this land: the hill country, the entire Negev, the whole region of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel and its foothills — ¹⁷ from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, all the way to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings, struck them down, and put them to death. ¹⁸ Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time. ¹⁹ Not one city made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites living in Gibeon — all the rest were taken in battle. ²⁰ For it was the LORD's purpose to harden their hearts so they would come against Israel in battle, and Israel would destroy them completely without mercy, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

²¹ At that time Joshua came and eliminated the Anakites from the hill country — from Hebron, Debir, Anab, and all the hill country of Judah and Israel. Joshua destroyed them and their cities completely. ²² None of the Anakites remained in Israelite territory; the only ones left were in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod. ²³ So Joshua took the entire land, just as the LORD had promised Moses, and he gave it as an inheritance to Israel, distributed among their tribes. And the land had rest from war.
